proposals.before: Also struck were ten Shanglin pond stewards, the chief and deputy for the palace birth-attendant corps, three eunuch-led directorates including Kun Terrace and the flying-archer guard, and twenty-one assistant posts.
proposals.after: Also struck were ten Shanglin pond stewards, the chief and deputy of the palace kitchen attendants, three eunuch-led directorates including Kun Terrace and the flying-archer guard, and twenty-one assistant posts.
proposals.reason: 胞人 is the Han kitchen/butcher office (通“庖”), not a birth or placenta attendant corps.

proposals.before: Further abolished were ten pool overseers of Shanglin, the chief and assistant of the placenta attendants, three directors of eunuchs, Kun Terrace, and flying archers, and twenty-one assistants.
proposals.after: Further abolished were ten pool overseers of Shanglin, the chief and assistant of the kitchen attendants, three directors of eunuchs, Kun Terrace, and flying archers, and twenty-one assistants.
proposals.reason: 胞人 is the Han kitchen/butcher office (通“庖”), not placenta attendants.

decisions.reason: In s0184 胞人长丞 sits with Shanglin pond stewards and other Shaofu service offices; 胞人 is the Han kitchen/butcher post (通庖), so 'birth-attendant corps' is a false reading and 'palace kitchen attendants' restores the office correctly.
The same 胞人长丞 is the kitchen/butcher office under the Privy Treasurer, not placenta attendants; 'kitchen attendants' matches the Chinese and the surrounding liquor-office and kitchen context.
